body.name: Measurable translation-aware equivariant lift
body.construction: For each regular identity-homotopic torus optimal-transport diffeomorphism \(F\), choose the unique triple \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(F)=(a_F,\phi_F,\widetilde F)\) such that \(a_F\in\mathcal Q\), \(\int_{\mathbb T^2}\phi_F=0\), and \(\widetilde F(x)=x+a_F+\nabla\phi_F(x)\) is \(\mathbb Z^2\)-equivariant. Extend this selector measurably to all map estimates by the fixed fallback \((0,0,\operatorname{id})\) off the regular domain, and define \(\operatorname{Disp}_{\mathbb T}(F,y)=-a_F-\nabla\phi_F(\widetilde y)\).
